竹简 · 水渍与旧刻痕: Bamboo slips · Water stains and old carvings
前九根竹色深浅不一，名字已难辨。最后一根是“衡”，旁边多出一道横，横末留着一点旧: The first nine slips are mottled dark and light, their names difficult to read. The last bears "Heng," with an extra stroke beside it and a small old mark at the end.
“衡”字旁多出一道横，横末有一点很黑的旧痕。: An extra stroke beside "Heng," with a very dark old mark at its end.
屈衡书房 · 请止西行: Qu Heng's study · Petition to end the western journeys
添笔的人: The one who added a stroke
十六岁，高一七班学生，家在宜昌一带，祖籍秭归。爱画地图与九层城，分科在即，常将没: Sixteen years old, a student in Class 7, Grade 11, living near Yichang and originally from Zigui. He likes drawing maps and nine-tiered cities. With subject choices coming up, he often leaves unsaid words to his imagination.
如果能离开这里，去另一个地方呢。: What if I could leave here and go somewhere else?
沈辞的邻居、班长与同桌，自己决定选文科。与沈辞因上周的一次表白变得局促，仍有自己: Shen Ci's neighbour, class monitor and deskmate. She chose arts for herself. Things became awkward with Shen Ci after he confessed the previous week, but she still has her own studies, plans and boundaries.
沈辞，我早饭就说过了。: Shen Ci, I told you at breakfast.
隔着过道坐的好友。嘴快，爱吃，也会在察觉不对时收起玩笑。: A friend who sits across the aisle. Quick to speak and fond of food. He knows when to put the jokes away if something is wrong.
它只是爆胎，别给它加工作量。: It only had a flat. Don't give it extra work.
十五岁的泽边少年。口吃，会生火、认鱼、削木鸟。沈辞借用他的身体，也逐渐听见他的习: A fifteen-year-old boy from the marsh. He stammers, can light a fire, recognise fish and carve wooden birds. Shen Ci borrows his body and gradually hears his habits and thoughts.
灶火旁等着的人: The one waiting by the hearth
将戌养大的老妇，耳背，针脚细。她仍等着没有归来的儿子阿禾，也记得把粥往火边挪一挪: The old woman who raised Xu, hard of hearing with fine stitches. She still waits for her son Ahe, who never returned, and remembers to move the porridge closer to the fire.
巫村年老的巫者，记得每一个被叫过的名字。他不知道两个人怎样同一口气，仍愿意等少年: The elderly shaman in the village remembers every name that has been called. He doesn't know how two people came to share one breath, but is still willing to wait until the boy finishes speaking.
旧箱与十根名简: The old chest and ten name slips
曾从少年巫旅独自归来的老臣，左手缺两指。四十多年前的旧衣与断笛，仍收在书房的箱中: An old minister who returned alone from a westward shaman expedition. He lost two fingers on his left hand. His old clothes and broken flute from more than forty years ago are still kept in the study chest.
屈府女孩，十二三岁，正在寻找走散的弟弟。做事爽快，针脚细，袖中常藏着一点饴糖。: A girl in Qu's household, twelve or thirteen, looking for her missing younger brother. She is brisk in her work, sews neat stitches, and often hides a piece of malt sugar in her sleeve.
先甜一下，省得你总皱脸。: Something sweet first, so you'll stop making that face.
听见路的人: The one who hears the road
蒙眼少女，以声音与触摸认路。肯等人说完，也会坦白自己听不清的地方。: A blindfolded girl who finds her way by sound and touch. She will wait for someone to finish speaking, and admit when she can't hear.
留着。明日还要撑船。: Keep that. You'll need it to pole the boat tomorrow.
失去舌头的少年，以手势、骨笛和乌鸦与人往来。喜欢笑，遇事有自己的主意。: A boy who lost his tongue and communicates through gestures, a bone flute and his crow. He likes to laugh and has a mind of his own.
想要一个高屋檐: Wanting a roof with high eaves
独臂少女，照料伤病，也管粮、管行李。习惯撑住别人，想有一个能挂许多药的屋檐。: A girl with one arm, caring for the sick and managing food and luggage. Used to holding others up, she wants a roof with room to hang plenty of medicine.
冷了就说，疼……也说。: Say when you're cold, and when it hurts too.
队伍里最小的男孩，常听见一条旁人听不到的河。分到两颗豆时，会把一颗放到旁边。: The youngest boy in the group, who often hears a river no one else can. When he receives two beans, he puts one beside him.
分粮仔细的女孩，左脸有胎记。想学烧带两只耳的罐：手小也好端，冬天就不怕掉了。: A girl who carefully counts the food, with a birthmark on her left cheek. She wants to learn to make a jar with two handles: easy for small hands to carry, so bowls won't fall in winter.
还不会。先画，碰见会的再学。: Not yet. Draw first, then learn when you meet someone who knows.
不得滞行: The journey must not be delayed
奉王令领孩子们西行的老巫。一路留下旧日记忆，身体与命令却越来越陌生。: An old shaman leading children west under the king's orders. He retains memories of an old life, but his body and commands grow more unfamiliar.
他的名字，在我的名牍上。: His name is on my register.

上学路 · 晨: On the way to school · Morning
把影子留在操场: Leaving his shadow on the field
一节很长的晚自习: A very long evening study session

旧箱里的月亮: The moon in the old chest
君无下此幽都些: Do not descend to that dark realm.
深山 · 来路: Deep in the mountains · The road behind
光河之岸 · 无时: By the river of light · Outside of time
以身份与证物，换仍活着的人退场。: Use the claim and evidence to let those still alive leave.
不再替王室落座，带着自己的名字离开。: Stop taking the royal family's place. Leave with your own name.
昨夜画了一遍又一遍的那条路，就在几步之外。: The road he drew over and over last night lay only a few steps away.
追问旧队名简，以三玉问旧日未归的人。: Ask about the old expedition's slips, then use the three pieces of jade to ask after those who never returned.
走过完整昆仑旅途，留下第二道裂纹。: Complete the Kunlun journey and leave the second crack.
亲历两条路线之后，回到那节未尽的晚自习。: After living both routes, return to that unfinished evening study session.
一句话，仍慢一点。所有人都等他讲完。: The sentence was still a little slow. Everyone waited until he had finished.
山与河之间，有一道未尽的淡痕。: Between mountain and river, a faint line remains unfinished.
从戌的小木匣中取出，贴着胸口，微凉。: Taken from Xu's small wooden box, cool against the chest.
屈衡保管的第二角，鸟眼还在。: The second fragment kept by Qu Heng. The bird's eye remains.
三处早年锯开的断口，终于相合。: The three breaks sawn long ago finally fit together.
一只尾歪，一只缺翅。都是戌做的。: One has a crooked tail, the other a broken wing. Xu made both.
用红绳扎着，曾藏过这个少年的来历。: Tied with red cord, it once held the story of this boy's origins.
两道裂纹，各自通往一种命运。: Two cracks, each leading to a different fate.
袖口接了一圈错色的靛青布，针脚很齐。: A mismatched strip of indigo cloth at the cuff, stitched neatly in place.
有一段调子，仍等着后来的人接上。: A phrase still waits for someone who comes later to take it up.

河风把六个名字送向群山: The river wind carries six names towards the mountains

高台千灯: A thousand lamps on the dais
铜铃与祭鼓之间，仍活着的人: Between bronze bells and ritual drums, those still alive
看不见的河，听得见的回声: An unseen river, an audible echo
冷了就说，疼也说: Say when you're cold. Say when it hurts.
风雪里，谁也没有松手: In wind and snow, no one let go.
光河上的名字: Names on the River of Light
记住一个名字，也记住一个人: Remember a name, and the person who bore it.
故事写到这里，日子还在继续: The story ends here. Life goes on.
